name: City Council Special Meeting
agenda_text:
December 6, 2022
6:30
PM
Council Chambers of City Hall
340 Palos Verdes Drive West
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
MAYOR'S REPORT - MATTERS OF COMMUNITY INTEREST
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT
CEREMONIAL
* Swearing-in of Officer Wroten
* Chief Best Recognition of Service
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC Members of the public may address the City Council on matters listed on the Special Meeting Agenda.
CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1-6)
1.
ACCEPTANCE OF $10,000 DONATION FROM CONFIDENCE FOUNDATION
Recommendation:  Accept the Donation as presented and thank the donor for their generosity.
1-Staff Report
2.
RECEIVE AND FILE THE QUARTERLY TREASURER’S REPORT FOR THE YEAR ENDING JUNE 30, 2022
Recommendation:  Receive and File.
2 - Staff Report
3.
RECEIPT AND FILING OF THE QUARTERLY TREASURER’S REPORT FOR THE QUARTER ENDING SEPTEMBER 30, 2022
Recommendation:  Receive and File.
3 - Staff Report
4.
RECEIPT AND FILING OF THE MONTHLY INVESTMENT TRANSACTION REPORTS FOR THE MONTH ENDING OCTOBER 31, 2022
Recommendation:  Receive and File.
4 - Staff Report
5.
CONFLICT OF INTEREST CODE AMENDMENT
Recommendation: Review and Adopt the Proposed Resolution Amending the City’s Conflict of Interest Code.
5 - Staff Report
6.
CONSIDERATION OF PROPOSED INCREASE IN PALOS VERDES BEACH AND ATHLETIC CLUB MEMBERSHIP INITIATION FEES EFFECTIVE JANUARY 1, 2023
Recommendation: Review and Consider Authorizing an Increase in the Palos Verdes Beach Club Membership Initiation Fees Effective January 1, 2023.
6 - Staff Report
OLD BUSINESS
7.
CONSIDERATION OF PROPOSED AMENDMENT NO. 2 TO THE LICENSE AGREEMENT FOR USE OF GEORGE ALLEN FIELD AND CONSENTING TO THE ASSIGNMENT OF THE AGREEMENT WITH PENNINSULA JUNIOR LITTLE LEAGUE
Recommendation: Approve Amendment No. 2 to the License Agreement for Use of George Allen Field with Peninsula Junior League Baseball (PJLB) and Consent to Assignment of the License Agreement from PJLB to Palos Verdes Little League (PVLL)
7 - Staff Report
Map - April 2021 George Allen Field License Agreement Exhibit A
8.
CONSIDER APPROVAL OF AMENDMENT NO. 5 TO THE CITYWIDE LANDSCAPE MAINTENANCE AGREEMENT WITH STAY GREEN, INC. TO EXTEND THE TERM OF THE AGREEMENT TO DECEMBER 31, 2023, AND MODIFY THE NOT TO EXCEED AMOUNT
Recommendation: Approve Amendment No. 5 to the Citywide Landscape Maintenance Agreement with Stay Green, Inc. to extend the term of the Agreement to December 31, 2023, and modify the not to exceed amount.
8 - Staff Report
9.
CONSIDERATION OF AMENDMENT NO. 6 TO THE PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT FOR BUILDING AND SAFETY, ENGINEERING, AND PUBLIC WORKS SERVICES WITH HR GREEN PACIFIC, INC. EXTENDING THE TERM OF THE AGREEMENT TO DECEMBER 31, 2024
Recommendation: Approve Amendment No. 6 to the Professional Services Agreement for Building and Safety, Engineering, and Public Works Services with HR Green Pacific, Inc. (HR Green) extending the term of the Agreement to December 31, 2024.
9 - Staff Report
NEW BUSINESS
10.
APPROVAL OF THE PALOS VERDES TENNIS CLUB’S 2023 PROPOSED OPERATING BUDGET AND REVISED DUES, CAPITAL FUND BUDGET AND FIVE-YEAR CAPITAL INVESTMENT FUND FORECAST
Recommendation: Approve the Palos Verdes Tennis Club’s (PVTC) 2023 proposed operating and capital budgets and revised fee schedule as submitted by the PVTC.
10 - Staff Report
11.
CONSIDER APPROVAL OF REVISED AND RESTATED CONCESSION AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES AND THE PALOS VERDES TENNIS FOUNDATION WITH MODIFICATIONS
Recommendation: Approve the Restatement and Renewal of the Concession Agreement between the City of Palos Verdes Estates and the Palos Verdes Tennis Foundation for the operation of the Palos Verdes Tennis Club
11 - Staff Report
12.
CONSIDERATION OF THE PROPOSED 2023 PALOS VERDES GOLF CLUB (PVGC) OPERATING, CAPITAL BUDGETS AND CHANGES TO THE PVGC FEE SCHEDULE
Recommendation: Approve the Palos Verdes Golf Club's (PVGC) proposed operating and capital budgets and the proposed schedule of dues and fees as submitted by the PVGC.
12 - Staff Report
MAYOR AND COUNCILMEMBER REPORTS
This portion of the agenda is reserved for the Mayor and Councilmembers to provide comments, report on community activities and ad hoc committees, and propose topics to be calendared on a future Council agenda.
Tentative Agenda
ADJOURNMENT TO TUESDAY, DECEMBER 13, AT 6:30 P.M.
